title: Time and Work
description: Learn efficiency ratios, combined work rates, and pipes & cisterns problems.
instructions: Use LCM method or one-day work fraction to solve efficiently.

questions.question: A can complete a task in 12 days and B can complete it in 24 days. Together, how many days will they take?
questions.explanation: Combined 1-day work = 1/12 + 1/24 = 3/24 = 1/8. So together they take 8 days.

questions.question: If 15 workers can build a wall in 10 days, how many days will 25 workers take?
Pipe A fills a tank in 6 hours and Pipe B empties it in 12 hours. If both are opened, how long will it take to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: Net fill per hour = 1/6 - 1/12 = 1/12. Hence it fills in 12 hours.
